brief: How to grow like a 20-person team — 10 systems that make 1 founder feel like 20.

slots.body: One founder can outpace a crowded startup by building systems that multiply output without multiplying burn.

slots.title: Automate your
slots.body: Use Zapier, Make, or n8n to connect your tools. Every repetitive task you eliminate buys back hours for deep work.

slots.title: Master the
slots.body: Create once, atomize everywhere. Turn one long-form piece into clips, carousels, threads, and newsletters to own every channel.

slots.title: Hire elite
slots.body: Skip local salary wars. Tap fractional specialists and overseas VAs who execute while you sleep, at a fraction of the cost.

slots.title: Productize your
slots.body: Stop selling custom projects. Package your expertise into repeatable products with clear pricing, fast delivery, and zero scope creep.

slots.title: Deploy AI
slots.body: Train chatbots on your docs and SOPs. Instant answers reduce churn, cut ticket volume, and free you from inbox slavery.

slots.title: Build decision
slots.body: Document every recurring choice in a simple SOP. When your business thinks for you, growth stops depending on your mood.
Steal these 6 systems and start scaling solo. Save this carousel and share it with a founder who needs leverage.
